item.title: [Game Boy Color] Double Duck
item.description: Double Duck Double Duck is a puzzle-platformer for Game Boy Color featuring a unique dual-character mechanic. Control two linked ducks simultaneously: Mars, the green duck, and Phobos, the purple duck. The two always stay at a fixed distance from each other, even if one of them ends up suspended in mid-air. Rotate Phobos around Mars clockwise with the B button, even through walls and solid terrain, to overcome obstacles. More info & Download : https://tardigrade-nx.
